special_traits.name: Diabolical Restoration
special_traits.description:
If the devil dies outside the
Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

special_traits.name: Magic Resistance
special_traits.description:
The devil has Advantage on saving
throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description:
The devil makes two Chain attacks and
uses Conjure Infernal Chain.

actions.name: Chain
actions.description:
Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6
+ 4) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of two chains, and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

actions.name: chain to bind a creature
actions.description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature the devil can see within 60 feet. Failure: 9 (2d4 + 4) Fire damage, and the target has

actions.name: the Restrained condition until the end of the devil's next turn, at which point the chain disappears
actions.description: If the target is Large or smaller, the devil moves the target up to 30 feet straight toward itself. Success: The chain disappears.

reactions.name: Unnerving Gaze
reactions.description: Trigger: A creature the devil can

reactions.name: see starts its turn within 30 feet of the devil and can see the devil
reactions.description: Response--Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, the triggering creature. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the end of its turn. Success: The target is immune to this devil's Unnerving Gaze for 24 hours.
